RAWALPINDI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
RAWALPINDI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(APPOINTMENT AND CONDITIONS OF SERVICE) REGULATIONS, 2012
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary
20th June, 2012]
No.RDA/DG/175, dated
26-5-2012.---In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 44 of the Punjab
Development of Cities Act, 1976, (XIX of 1976), the Rawalpindi Development
Authority is pleased to make the following regulations, namely:---
PART I -- GENERAL
1. (i) The Regulation
may be called the Rawalpindi Development Authority (Appointment and Conditions
of Service) Regulations,
2012.
(ii) They shall come into
force at once.
(iii) They shall apply to all
employees of the Rawalpindi Development Authority.
2. Definitions.---In these Regulations, unless the context otherwise
requires the following expressions shall have the meanings hereby respectively
assigned to them that is to say:---
(a) "Appointing
authority" in relation to a post means the person authorized under
regulation 6 to make appointment to that post.
(b) "Autonomous or
semi-autonomous organization" means an organization set up under a law
by the Government.
(c) "Committee"
means a Promotion Committee or Selection Committee.
(d) "Competent
Authority" means the appointing Authority or a person duly authorized
by the appointing authority in that behalf not being a person lower in rank to
the employee concerned.
(e) "Appellate
Authority" means the next above the competent authority to which an
appeal lies against the orders of the competent authority and appellate
authority against the orders of the Director General will be the Secretary
HUD&PHE Department, Government of the Punjab.
(f) "Director
General" means the Director General of the Authority.
(g) "Employee"
means an employee of the Authority but does not include:
(i) a person on deputation
to the authority from the Government of Pakistan or an autonomous or semi
autonomous organization, and
(ii) a person who is employed
on contract or on work charged basis or who is paid from contingencies.
(h) "Group"
means a group of employees in the same grade performing similar duties.
(i) "Initial
Recruitment" means appointment made otherwise than by promotion or
transfer from Government or the Government of Pakistan or Autonomous or
Semi-autonomous organization.
(j) "Managing
Director" means the Managing Director of an Agency or Authority.
(k) "Post"
means a post in connection with the affairs of the Authority.
(l) "Prescribed"
means prescribed by these Regulations.
(m) "Regulation"
means the Rawalpindi Development Authority (Appointment and Conditions of
Service) Regulations, 2012.
(n) "Schedule"
means the schedule to these Regulations.
(o) "Service"
means the service of the Authority.
(p) "Temporary
post" means a post created for limited period of time.
(q) Words and expressions
used but not defined shall bear the same meanings as they bear in the Punjab
Civil Servants Act, 1974 and Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976.
3. (i) Appointment to posts shall be made by promotion,
transfer or initial recruitment as specified in the schedule.
(ii) Appointment by promotion
or transfer shall be made in accordance with part II and by initial recruitment
in accordance with part III of these Regulations.
4. (i) There shall be one or
more Promotion Committees and Selection Committees to be constituted with the
approval of the Governing Body
(ii) Each such committee
shall consist of at least three members one of whom shall be appointed as
Chairman of that Committee.
5. Where an appointing
authority other than the Rawalpindi Development Authority does not accept the
recommendation of a Committee, it shall record reasons thereof and submit a
summary of the case for information to the next higher authority.
6. The authorities competent
to make appointment to various grades shall be as specified in column 4 of the
schedule.
